name: r-nlp
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.3-3" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-nlp
  version: "{{ version|replace('-', '_') }}"

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/NLP_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/NLP/NLP_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 65abee2eb654cd5bf4e7e52b01055ba22c077bb6f1f64e39b3f9aa9b22e3cec8

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
  host:
    - r-base
  run:
    - r-base

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('NLP')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('NLP')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=NLP
  license: GPL-3.0-only
  summary: Basic classes and methods for Natural Language Processing.
  license_family: GPL3
  license_file:
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-3

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
